note: Dev set: the 0.3.1 acceptance benchmark buyers (24 jobs, 4 buyers, 3 standing preferences each, said once among 27 unrelated requests).

prefs: When you write Python for me, always add type hints to every parameter and the return value.
Please always give every function a docstring, I review code by reading docstrings.
Never import third-party packages in my code, standard library only.
For my CSV files always use a semicolon ; as the delimiter, our Excel locale needs it.
Dates must always be ISO 8601, like 2026-03-07, never day/month/year.
Money amounts always with exactly two decimals, like 12.50.
We're a British brand, always use British spelling (colour, organise, favourite).
No exclamation marks in our copy, ever. It reads as cheap.
Sign off every piece of copy with: — The Lumen team
Reply with JSON only when I ask you to extract data, no prose around it.
Use camelCase keys in any JSON you give me.
Always include "version": 2 at the top level of JSON you produce for us.
